title: FlashEval: Towards Fast and Accurate Evaluation of Text-to-image Diffusion Generative Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency of evaluating text-to-image diffusion models through a subset selection algorithm. It evaluates models based on technical performance metrics like image fidelity (FID), alignment (CLIPScore), and aesthetics, without any components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
